cases.refreshed: Rescue Readers is a one-hour program for all readers, where participants read to the animals at the SJ Animal Care Adoption Center. Readers provide soothing company to dogs, cats, and critters as they await adoption. As a bonus, new readers gain confidence and improve their reading skills. Registration is Required.

cases.refreshed: Want to try to create something and print it into reality? Come join the Alum Rock 3D Printing Club! We meet once a month to use Tinkercad and our imaginations to design and print objects using our 3D printer. Staff will be on hand to demonstrate Tinkercad and Orca Slicer and help with designing and slicing objects. Spaces are limited, so registration is recommended as soon as possible. Registration will open seven days before program date. Depending on attendance, objects may not be available to pick up by the end of the club meeting date. All objects will be printed in PLA filament. If you are waitlisted, we may introduce additional sessions depending on demand. Waitlisted patrons will be emailed. Please keep an eye on your email for openings.

events.title: Friends of the Milpitas Library Big Winter Book Sale

cases.refreshed: Our quarterly 4-Day Sales feature a large number of books and media from all genres. The sales begin with a preview evening exclusively for Friends members and end with a Bargain Day. Prices at 4-Day Sales are as follows: Books: $1.50 per inch; CDs: (music and software) 4 for $1.00; Audio books, DVDs, VCDs and Blu Ray discs: $1 each; Software and games: $1 each or as marked; Box sets of DVDs, CDs, or VCDs: individually priced based on the number of discs in the set; Specialty items: Individually priced; Bargain Day Sales: $5 per paper grocery bag full of books and media. We accept the following forms of payment: Cash & Checks; All major Credit Cards; Apple Pay & Google Pay; Contactless payment available. Thursday, December 3 is members-only night. Doors open from 5:00 PM until 8:00 PM. For Thursday night access to the sale, enter at the rear (east side) of the library. You must have a valid membership card for entry, or purchase a membership at the door. Individual memberships allow 1 person to enter; family memberships allow the entire family to enjoy the book sale. You must be present to hold a place in line – you cannot "save" your spot with boxes or other items. Learn more about memberships. Friday, December 4 is open to the public. Doors open from 10:00 AM until 5:00 PM. Saturday, December 5 is open to the public. Doors open from 10:00 AM until 5:00 PM. Sunday, December 6 is open to the public and is bargain day. Doors open from 10:00 AM until 4:00 PM. Other Ongoing Friends of the Milpitas Library Sales The Book Nook We have a variety of great books available at great prices every day in the Book Nook behind the accounts desk on the first floor. All books are 50% off every Sunday. Amazon Sales We have a large catalog of books for sale on Amazon, and we try to offer the lowest price for every title that we list. The next time you're shopping for a used book on Amazon, look for our seller name: Friends of the Milpitas Community Library. Ebay Sales View our current listings on Ebay. For accessibility accommodations (e.g., ASL), please fill out the online form at sccld.org/accessibility 7+ days prior to the event. If you need assistance with the form, speak with a staff member at your local library, call (408) 540-3945, or email us at ask@lib.sccgov.org.

cases.refreshed: Celebrate Native American Heritage Month with the 1998 film Smoke Signals. Smoke Signals--one of the first feature films to be written, directed, and produced by Native Americans--won the Audience Award at Sundance. The film follows Victor Joseph and Thomas Builds-the-Fire, who travel from their Idaho reservation to collect the ashes of Victor's estranged father. Rated PG-13; 89 minutes Movie trailer: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vQhviwp8j38 Free. No registration required.
